I am a Data Engineer with more than five years of experience building reliable,
scalable, and production-ready data platforms across AWS and Azure.

I am currently completing my M.S. in Data Science at
**Willamette University**. My capstone project
[forecasts future U.S. unemployment](capstone.qmd) at three-, six-, and twelve-month horizons using public macroeconomic data, chronological model evaluation, and historical lead–lag analysis.

My interests include data engineering, cloud-native architectures, distributed
data processing, machine learning, and transforming complex data into useful
business insights.

**Currently seeking Data Engineer opportunities.**
[Get in touch](about.qmd) or view my [resume](resume.qmd).
